title: Maple leaf with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='leafGrad' cx='50%' cy='45%' r='55%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff6b35'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#cc2200'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- stem -->
  <rect x='47' y='80' width='6' height='14' rx='2' fill='#a0522d'/>
  <rect x='47' y='80' width='3' height='14' rx='1' fill='#c87040'/>
  <!-- main leaf body -->
  <path d='M50 18 L58 34 L72 28 L68 44 L84 48 L72 58 L80 72 L62 66 L58 82 L50 72 L42 82 L38 66 L20 72 L28 58 L16 48 L32 44 L28 28 L42 34 Z'
        fill='url(#leafGrad)' stroke='#ff8855' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- center vein -->
  <line x1='50' y1='72' x2='50' y2='24' stroke='#ffaa77' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- side veins -->
  <line x1='50' y1='50' x2='30' y2='40' stroke='#ffaa77' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='50' x2='70' y2='40' stroke='#ffaa77' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='60' x2='34' y2='58' stroke='#ffaa77' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='60' x2='66' y2='58' stroke='#ffaa77' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='46' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#2a1a10'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='46' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#2a1a10'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='44' rx='2' ry='2.5' fill='#ffeecc'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='44' rx='2' ry='2.5' fill='#ffeecc'/>
  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='53' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#ff9966' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='53' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#ff9966' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M40 55 Q50 66 60 55' stroke='#2a1a10' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
